texts.zh:
在一次于[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]地表执行的秘密任务中，我方一架穿梭机被当地某个国家政权的大气层战斗机中队拦截。一枚幸运的导弹击中了穿梭机引擎，导致它在偏远的荒野中坠毁。

若想在[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]到达坠毁地点之前救出所有幸存者，我们必须迅速行动。所有我们存在的证据都必须抹除！
texts.en:
During a clandestine mission to the surface of [pre_ftl_planet.GetName], one of our shuttles was intercepted by a squadron of atmospheric fighters belonging to a local nation state. A lucky missile hit disabled the shuttle's engines, and it crashed in a remote wilderness.

We need to act fast if we are to evacuate any survivors before the [GetPreFTLLowerPlural] reach the crash site. All evidence of our presence must be removed!

texts.zh:
在一次于[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]地表执行的秘密任务中，我方一架穿梭机被不明身份的大气战斗机中队拦截。一枚幸运的导弹击中了穿梭机引擎并使其失效，导致它在偏远的荒野中坠毁。

若想在[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]到达坠毁地点之前救出所有幸存者，我们必须迅速行动。所有我们存在的证据都必须抹除！
texts.en:
During a clandestine mission to the surface of [pre_ftl_planet.GetName], one of our shuttles was intercepted by a squadron of atmospheric fighters belonging to an unidentified mind. A lucky missile hit disabled the shuttle's engines, and it crashed in a remote wilderness.

We need to act fast if we are to evacuate any survivors before the [GetPreFTLLowerPlural] reach the crash site. All evidence of our presence must be removed!

texts.zh:
穿梭机XB-23-968H，前往[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]执行秘密观察任务V45-BM时，被不明国家的大气层战斗机中队拦截，并报告发生了严重失控。我们追踪到其坠毁地点。

在任何[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]到达坠毁点之前，所有自主无人机都必须撤离，并消灭所有我们存在的证据。
texts.en:
Shuttle XB-23-968H, inbound for covert observation mission V45-BM on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has reported critical failure after being intercepted by a squadron of atmospheric fighters, belonging to an unidentified local nation state. We have tracked its location to an uninhabited region.

All autonomous drones must be evacuated, and all evidence of our presence removed before any [GetPreFTLLowerPlural] reach the crash site.

texts.zh:
我们的穿梭机，前往[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]执行一项秘密观察任务时，被大气层战斗机中队拦截，并报告发生了严重失控。我们追踪到其坠毁地点。

在[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]到达坠毁点之前，所有自主[GetIndividualNamePlural]都必须撤离，并消灭所有我们存在的证据。
texts.en:
Our shuttle, inbound for a covert observation mission on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has reported a critical failure after being intercepted by a squadron of atmospheric fighters. We have tracked its location to an uninhabited region.

All autonomous [GetIndividualNamePlural] must be evacuated, and all evidence of our presence removed before any [GetPreFTLLowerPlural] reach the crash site..

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]的特工成功将数名生还者从坠毁在[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的穿梭机中救出。剩余的残骸在一次受控爆中被摧毁，只剩下一个小坑洞供[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]搜寻。

这一事故发生地的国家无疑会归咎于邻国对边境的侵犯，希望这次事件对他们自然发展所造成的破坏能够尽量减小。
texts.en:
Operatives from the [Root.GetName] managed to evacuate several survivors from the crashed shuttle on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]. The remaining debris was destroyed in a controlled explosion, leaving nothing but a small crater for the [GetPreFTLLowerPlural] to find.

The nation state where the incident occurred will no doubt blame its neighbors for this border violation, but hopefully the disruption to their natural development will prove minimal.

texts.zh:
[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的[GetPreFTLUpper]军队在我们找到坠机的研究团队之前抵达了坠毁点，所有幸存者均被俘。

[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]在穿梭机的残骸周围设下了防线，他们最好的科学家无疑正在对其进行分析。

他们现在有确凿的证据证实，在他们自己的星球之外亦有生命存在。这究竟会对他们的社会造成什么影响还有待观察……
texts.en:
[GetPreFTLUpper] forces on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] arrived at the crash site before we could get to our downed research team, and all survivors have been captured.

The [GetPreFTLLowerPlural] have established a perimeter around the shuttle wreckage, and their best scientists are no doubt in the process of analyzing it.

They now have indisputable evidence that life exists beyond their own world. Exactly what effect this will have on their society remains to be seen...

texts.zh:
从我们在[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上坠落的航天器上搜出的技术对这颗星球上的所有生命构成威胁。由于我们缺乏相应的科学理解，他们可以轻易地利用我们的技术来摧毁自己。

除非我们进行干预，否则这将是一场灾难。
texts.en:
The technology scavenged from our downed shuttle on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] poses a threat to all life on the planet. Lacking our scientific understanding, they could easily use our tech to destroy themselves.

Unless we intervene, this will be a disaster.

label.zh: 激活航天飞机自毁功能。

texts.zh:
[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的几个国家联合起来对抗击落我们穿梭机的那个国家，因为后者拒绝分享从坠毁现场回收得到的科技。

在短暂的常规战争之后，双方互相发射了大量的核导弹，彻底摧毁了[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]的大部分地区。

地表上没有发现任何幸存者，包括我们被俘的科学家，并且环境也受到了明显破坏。
texts.en:
Several of the nation states on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] have banded together against the one that shot down our shuttle, after the latter refused to share the technologies they recovered from the crash site.

Following a brief conventional war, both sides obliterated each other in a massive exchange of nuclear missiles that ruined most of the [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat].

There are no survivors on the surface, including our captured scientists, and the environment has taken significant damage.

texts.zh:

在短暂的常规战争之后，双方互相发射了大量的核导弹，彻底摧毁了[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]的大部分地区。

Our captured scientists are counted among the billions of dead.

texts.zh:
[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的几个国家联合起来对抗击落我们穿梭机的那个国家，因为后者拒绝分享从坠毁现场回收得到的科技。

在短暂的常规战争之后，双方互相发射了大量的核导弹，彻底摧毁了[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]的大部分地区。

[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]遭到了严重破坏，所有大型城市都被摧毁，90%以上的人口死亡。虽然各地有零星的幸存者从废墟中出现，但我们预测，[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]的文明将倒退至某个极其欠发展的状态。我们被俘的[root.GetIndividualNamePlural]也在数十亿亡者之列。
texts.en:

Following a brief conventional war, both sides obliterated each other in a massive exchange of nuclear missiles that ruined most of the [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat].

Our captured [root.GetIndividualNamePlural] are counted among the billions of dead.

label.zh: 要是我们的穿梭机没有坠毁就好了……
label.en: If only our shuttle had made it out...

texts.zh: [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上击落我方穿梭机的国家，逼迫我方被俘虏的科学家为其军队设计新式武器。凭借这些装备，他们成功入侵了数个邻国，现在正如火如荼地将整个[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]纳入自己的统治。
texts.en: The nation state on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] that shot down our shuttle has forced our captured scientists to design new instruments of war for their military. With this equipment, they have successfully invaded several neighboring states and are now in the process of uniting the entire [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat] under their rule.

texts.zh:
[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上击落我们穿梭机的国家通过他们的一颗卫星向太空发送了公开讯号。看上去是发送给我们的。

他们要求我们与他们分享一些先进的技术，以换取他们在坠机点俘虏的科学家的性命。如果我们拒绝，我们的科学家将经由他们简陋的无线视频广播系统被公开处决。
texts.en:
The nation state on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] that shot down our shuttle has sent an open transmission into space through one of their satellites. It appears to be intended for us.

They are demanding that we share some of our advanced technology with them in exchange for the lives of the scientists they captured at the shuttle crash site. If we refuse, our scientists are to be publicly executed live on their crude televised broadcasting system.

label.zh: 我们人民的安全应该放在第一位。
label.en: The safety of our people comes first.

label.zh: 必须优先考虑我们自主单元的安全。
label.en: The safety of our autonomous units comes first.

label.zh: 他们现在还不能接触这些科技。

texts.zh: 在这个我们只能用粗野来形容的场面中，我们在[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上被俘虏的科学家，在现场直播的镜头下被当作“外星憎恶”游行示众。
texts.en: In what can only be described as an obscene spectacle, our captured scientists on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] were paraded in front of the cameras on live television as "alien horrors."

texts.zh: 我们的一架穿梭机被[pre_ftl_country.GetName]的原住民击落，我们必须在幸存者被当地军队俘虏之前把他们全数救出。
texts.en: One of our shuttles was shot down by the natives on [pre_ftl_country.GetName], and we need to rescue any surviving operatives before they are captured by local forces.
